hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a long distance without any refuge or marked crossing points.

hazards.name: High Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes with minimal friction encourage high vehicle speeds in an area where pedestrians may need to cross.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Large parked vehicles, particularly the truck on the right and cars on the left, block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signage are visible, requiring pedestrians to cross an unmarked roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Construction
interventions.description: Install concrete curbs to define the roadway edge, manage drainage, and provide a physical vertical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Formalized On-Street Parking
interventions.description: Mark parking stalls and install signage to organize vehicle storage and prevent encroachment into pedestrian walking zones.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous, paved, and ADA-compliant sidewalk to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Add street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during evening hours.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Installation
interventions.description: Install curbs to define the roadway edge and prevent vehicles from parking in pedestrian zones.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint high-visibility crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at the intersection to shorten crossing distances and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a furniture zone or planting strip between the curb and the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer from traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps designed for pedestrians to improve visibility and safety during evening hours.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct a standard-width sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement Markings
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility lane markings to define travel lanes and parking areas, reducing vehicle conflict.

interventions.title: Install a formal sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant paved walkway to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic and parking areas.

interventions.title: Define vehicle access points
interventions.description: Install curbs and clearly defined driveway entrances to minimize the conflict zone between vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pavement repair and maintenance
interventions.description: Resurface the cracked pavement to eliminate tripping hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Paint center lines and parking lane markings to organize traffic flow and clearly define the pedestrian realm.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the sidewalk access point to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Enhanced Driveway Markings
interventions.description: Apply high-visibility pavement markings where the pedestrian path crosses the vehicle access zone to reinforce pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add a planting strip with street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and moving traffic.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with appropriate signage to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Install a raised sidewalk
interventions.description: Construct a dedicated, curb-separated sidewalk to provide a safe and predictable space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Frontage improvements
interventions.description: Encourage the addition of windows or public art to the blank wall to improve the visual quality and safety of the street edge.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to reduce vehicle speeds on this narrow, mixed-use street.

interventions.title: Sidewalk repair
interventions.description: Repair and level the concrete walkway to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility.

interventions.title: Driveway markings
interventions.description: Use high-visibility paint or continuous sidewalk materials across the driveway to clearly indicate pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Construct a Protected Sidewalk
interventions.description: Install a raised sidewalk with a curb to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians separated from the parking lot and roadway.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation and Narrowing
interventions.description: Replace the wide open apron with defined, narrowed driveway entrances to slow turning vehicles and reduce the pedestrian conflict zone.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the degraded asphalt to eliminate trip hazards and improve accessibility for all users.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Extension
interventions.description: Construct a continuous sidewalk along the full length of the block to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions and Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks and curb extensions to reduce crossing distances and improve pedestrian visibility at potential crossing points.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Add high-visibility warning signs or a Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB) to alert drivers to the crossing.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to provide space for a center turn lane or median refuge and dedicated bike lanes, slowing traffic and shortening crossing distances.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crossing with a raised median refuge to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at potential crossing points to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking too close to the crossing.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffers
interventions.description: Widen the existing narrow sidewalks and add a furniture or planting zone to separate pedestrians from traffic and parked cars.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the walkway and the curb to provide greater physical separation from parked and moving vehicles.
